title: Floral performance
body:
### **FLORAL PERFORMANCE**
_a floral tech modpack_

Floral performance offers good performance through mods like sodium, ferritecore and dynamic fps, while making your performance bloom with visual QOL mods like subtle effects and better clouds. **Make minecraft feel fresh yet familiar again.**
